assist2017.interpretation: Earlier event-index responses can affect predictions even where that response completes after the query presentation (EdNet completion uses timestamp+elapsed proxy). This differs from future-index/self-label leakage.
assist2017.sample_scope: Eight distinct test sessions with an overlapping previous response, target length<=256 and history<=1024; diagnostic only
